audit.whatIsWrong: Level chart contradicted itself and the mirror: rows 1-3 were given to Tryndamere in both layers while the whys said 'Level 3 favors you' and 'Levels 4-5 stay yours'. The already-audited tryndamere__warwick file has rows 0-3 as Warwick and level 6 as Skill.
audit.why: Tryndamere has no Fury banked pre-6, so Bloodlust (Q, 12s flat) has nothing to heal with, while Warwick's Eternal Hunger and Jaws of the Beast heal every trade.
audit.corrected: Rows 0-3 set to Warwick in phases[].side and win[] together, row 4 (Level 6) left Skill, rows 5-6 left Tryndamere. Ratings on rows 0-3 raised to match, and whys[1]/phases[1].why rewritten so Level 2 no longer reads as even.

audit.why: Four spikes present with real timings: pre-Fury window, Undying Rage at 6, first-item crit, late split. Blade of the Ruined King as the Warwick spike matches the %HP theme of Jaws of the Beast.
audit.corrected: Left as written; spikes[2].text tightened to name the Mocking Shout disengage trap that was missing.

audit.whatIsWrong: The pages never mention Mocking Shout's back-turned condition, and Primal Howl was referred to only as 'fear' with no damage-reduction or cooldown detail.
audit.why: Mocking Shout (W, 14s flat, 850 range) only slows targets whose backs are turned to Tryndamere, so walking away from him after a trade is what gets you killed — turning and holding ground denies the slow entirely. Primal Howl (E, 15/14/13/12/11s) gives 2.5s of damage reduction, which is the window that eats a crit burst, and the recast fear buys the disengage.
audit.corrected: dontsFull[2].d and tradeBad now state Primal Howl's damage reduction and cooldown; spikes[2].text states the back-turned Mocking Shout condition. dosFull[0].d now carries Undying Rage's 120s rank-1 cooldown.

audit.why: Undying Rage at 120/100/80 is the punishable cooldown and the text already keys every commit to it.

edits.after: Fighting with Primal Howl down — its 2.5s damage reduction is what eats his crit burst, and it is 15s at rank 1.
